integrity: The original Gaussian logarithm identity and Fourier limit proof are stated explicitly; finite numerical checks corroborate, not certify, the asymptotic mathematics.
scientific_limitations: Strictly positive C1 coefficient-variance profile on [0,1]; compact-uniform fixed-real-parameter n-limit; d-tail only after limiting covariance; no CLT or zero-count covariance; historical priority not independently certified.
title: Profile-sensitive two-circle Gaussian Jensen covariance and sharp radial decorrelation
